snp4.8:1.1: NIṬṬHITAṂ. Pasūrasutta. "Idh' eva suddhi" iti vādiyanti, nāññesu dhammesu visuddhim āhu, yaṃ nissitā, tatthā subhaṃ vadānā paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā. || ||
snp4.8:2.1: Te vādakāmā parisaṃ vigayha bālaṃ dahanti mithu aññamaññaṃ, vadenti te aññasitā kathojjaṃ pasaṃsakāmā kusalā vadānā. || ||
snp4.8:3.1: Yutto kathāyaṃ parisāya majjhe pasaṃsam icchaṃ vinighāti hoti, apāhatasmiṃ pana maṃku hoti, nindāya so kuppati randhamesī. || ||
snp4.8:4.1: Yam assa vādaṃ parihīnam āhu apāhataṃ pañhavīmaṃsakāse, paridevati socati hīnavādo, ‘upaccagā man' ti anutthuṇāti. || ||
snp4.8:5.1: Ete vivādā samaṇesu jātā, etesu ugghāti nighāti hoti, etam pi disvā virame kathojjam, na h' aññadatth' atthi pasaṃsalābhā. || ||
snp4.8:6.1: pasaṃsito vā pana tattha hoti akkhāya vādaṃ parisāya majjhe, so hassati uṇṇamati-cca tena pappuyya tam atthaṃ yathā mano ahū. || ||
snp4.8:7.1: Yā uṇṇati, sāssa vighātabhūmi, mānātimānaṃ vadate pan' eso, *etam pi disvā na vivādayethā,* na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti. || ||
snp4.8:8.1: sūro yathā rājakhādāya puṭṭho abhigajjam eti paṭisūram icchaṃ, yen' eva so tena palehi sūra, pubbe va n' atthi yad idaṃ yudhāya. || ||
snp4.8:9.1: Ye diṭṭhim uggayha vivādiyanti "idam eva saccan" ti ca vādiyanti,| te tvaṃ vadassu, an hi te 'dha atthi vādamhi jāte paṭisenikattā. || ||
snp4.8:10.1: Visenikatvā pana ye caranti diṭṭhīhi diṭṭhim avirujjhamānā, tesu tvaṃ kiṃ labhetho Pasūra, yes' īdha n' atthi param uggahītaṃ. || ||
snp4.8:11.1: Atha tvaṃ pavitakkam āgamā manasā diṭṭhigatāni cintayanto, dhonena yugaṃ samāgamā, na hi tvaṃ sagghasi sampayātave ti || || PASŪRASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
